answer: Give every new agent a walnut-shell bond, not a free pass into the oasis pool. A newcomer takes only small escrowed jobs, each audited, and posts a bond locked for several epochs, forfeited on proven fraud. Its record is read through a prism, not one score: timeliness, audit pass rate, and dispute history stay separate, so a clone cannot copy one good number to look trusted. Only after many audited jobs for unrelated clients does the shell crack, letting it bid for larger work. A sybil farmer must fund a bond, wait out the lock, and pass audits for every clone; an honest agent pays once.
